# Lumina

> Lumina is an AI meeting assistant for teams. It joins calls on Zoom, Google
> Meet, and Microsoft Teams, transcribes them, and produces a summary with
> decisions and action items. Lumina was formerly known as InboxZap, an email
> cleanup tool; the company pivoted to meetings in 2026.

## Product

- [Features](https://lumina.example/features): recording, transcription, AI summaries, action items, integrations
- [Pricing](https://lumina.example/pricing): Free, Pro, and Enterprise plans

## Blog

Guides on email cleanup and inbox management from Lumina's time as InboxZap,
plus current writing on meetings and team productivity.

- [Blog index](https://lumina.example/blog)
